d: Nominated by Ajinkya Rahane, spin maestro Ravichandran Ashwin takes on the "Ajab Sawaal Ghazab Jawaab" fan challenge! Watch Ashwin tackle questions across easy, medium, and hard levels—from picking his Fab Five and India’s 2027 World Cup pace attack, to revealing alternate careers for MS Dhoni and Virat Kohli. Don't miss who he nominates next!
